parse_sigrid_output: parse Sigrid replayer stdout to extract request count, exceptions, and latency metrics into a dictionary
use_sigrid_parser: instantiate SigridParser and call parse with stdout lines, stderr, and returncode to get benchmark metrics
extract_latency_percentiles: use the lat_regex pattern to extract latency percentiles like p25, p50, p90, p95, and p99 from output lines
extract_server_latency: use the slat_regex pattern to extract server-side latency percentiles from Sigrid benchmark output
extend_regex_map: add new regex patterns to regex_map to extract additional metrics from Sigrid replayer output
